name: The Bathysphere Logs
intro: Eleven hundred metres down, the cable went slack and the radio went strange. What came back up the line was not speech.

echoes.ABYSS: Stare long enough into the dark below, the philosopher warned, and something stares back.
echoes.TRENCH: Soldiers once lived for years in long ditches; the sea keeps one seven miles deep.
echoes.KRAKEN: Tennyson wrote that it sleeps below the thunders of the upper deep, and will rise only once.
echoes.PRESSURE: Every ten metres down, the sea leans a little harder on the hull, and the hull remembers every one.
echoes.LEVIATHAN: Job was asked whether he could draw it out with a hook; Hobbes named a whole commonwealth after it.
echoes.UNDERTOW: What drowns strong swimmers is never the wave you can see, but the pull going the other way beneath it.

name: Cold Storage, Freezer B
intro: Someone left the minus-eighty open overnight. Half the samples are ruined; the other half have started talking.

echoes.HELIX: Two railings, one staircase, and a photograph in 1952 that someone else took.
echoes.GENOME: The whole library, every volume, copied into every room of the house.
echoes.MUTANT: Every one of us differs from our parents in about sixty places. Some of us rather more.
echoes.CODON: Somewhere in this building, everything is read three letters at a time.
echoes.RIBOSOME: A small factory, half built from the very kind of message it reads.
echoes.CHIMERA: A few of the mice in cage four are two animals at once, and perfectly happy about it.
echoes.PHENOTYPE: What the code says is one thing; what walks out of the incubator is another.

name: Mission Control, Night Shift
intro: The probe was declared lost in 1994. Last night, it phoned home, and it had clearly been practising.

echoes.ORBIT: Everything up there is falling. It just keeps missing.
echoes.NEBULA: Stars are born in clouds, like most bad ideas.
echoes.QUASAR: The brightest lights in the sky are hungry, and very far away.
echoes.ECLIPSE: For a few minutes, the day forgot to happen.
echoes.PULSAR: The first one was so regular that its discoverers labelled it LGM, for little green men.
echoes.COMET: It comes back every seventy-six years, and last time hardly anybody looked up.
echoes.SUPERNOVA: Every atom of iron in your blood was forged by something dying spectacularly.
echoes.GRAVITY: Newton blamed an apple; Einstein blamed the shape of space itself.

name: Series Z
intro: The startup pivoted eleven times in one quarter. The last pivot left a trail of cryptic commit messages and a whiteboard nobody is allowed to erase.

echoes.STARTUP: Every giant in the valley began in somebody's garage.
echoes.UNICORN: The investors are hunting for a mythical beast worth a billion.
echoes.KERNEL: At the heart of every machine, and every nut, there is a small hard core.
echoes.BINARY: There are ten kinds of engineer: those who get the joke, and those who don't.
echoes.COMPILER: Someone has to translate what you meant into what the machine will actually do.
echoes.SEGFAULT: The program reached for memory that wasn't its own, and was shot for it.
echoes.DEADLOCK: Two engineers each wait politely for the other to go first. Forever.

name: Hut Eight
intro: A drawer at Bletchley Park was found to have a false bottom. Beneath it: a stack of intercepts that were never logged, each one pinned to a different page of a crossword.

echoes.ENIGMA: Elgar wrote variations on it; the Kriegsmarine typed on it.
echoes.CIPHER: A nobody, a zero and a secret, all spelled the same way.
echoes.ROTOR: Three wheels, turning one notch at a time, like an odometer that lies.
echoes.BOMBE: The Poles built the first one and, the story goes, named it after an ice-cream dessert.
echoes.TURING: He asked whether machines could think, and did not live to see them try.
echoes.ULTRA: The secret was graded above Most Secret, and there was only one word left for it.
echoes.COLOSSUS: One wonder of the ancient world stood astride the harbour at Rhodes; its namesake stood in Block H.

name: The Inside Job
intro: The plan was perfect, which is why nobody wrote it down. Instead, each member of the crew hid their part of it somewhere only the others would think to look.

echoes.VAULT: The architect gave the strongroom an arched ceiling, as if it were a cathedral.
echoes.HEIST: Everyone in the crew has seen the films, and everyone thinks theirs will end differently.
echoes.JACKPOT: Three cherries in a row, and every light and bell in the building goes off.
echoes.GETAWAY: The driver has been idling around the corner since before any of this began.
echoes.SAFECRACKER: One of the crew sands their fingertips before every job, to feel the tumblers fall.
echoes.BULLION: The bars are stamped, stacked in pyramids, and weigh four hundred troy ounces apiece.

name: 221B, Upstairs
intro: The detective has vanished, leaving only a violin with one string retuned and a stack of notes addressed to whoever is clever enough to read them.

echoes.CULPRIT: It is always the person you trusted with the tea.
echoes.MOTIVE: Means and opportunity are easy. The hard part is why.
echoes.SLEUTH: The word once meant the track an animal leaves; now it means whoever follows it.
echoes.DEDUCE: When you have eliminated the impossible, whatever remains is the answer.
echoes.ALIBI: Latin for 'elsewhere', which is precisely where everyone claims to have been.
echoes.CONFESSION: In the end, somebody always wants to tell.

name: The Last Expedition
intro: The ship was crushed by pack ice in the first winter. What survives of the expedition is a biscuit tin full of messages, each written in a different hand, and each deliberately obscure.

echoes.AURORA: Some nights the sky above the camp moves like a curtain in a draught.
echoes.GLACIER: The river behind the tents moves a foot a day, and it is made of ice.
echoes.BLIZZARD: For three days nobody could see the next tent.
echoes.POLARIS: The navigator trusted only one star: the one that never moved.
echoes.ENDURANCE: Shackleton's family motto was Fortitudine vincimus, and he named his ship after it.
echoes.PERMAFROST: Dig down a foot and the ground has been frozen since the mammoths.

name: The Clockmaker's Will
intro: The old clockmaker left everything to whichever apprentice could finish the last clock. It has no face, no hands, and fourteen drawers.

echoes.PENDULUM: Galileo timed a swinging lamp in Pisa cathedral against his own pulse.
echoes.SUNDIAL: The oldest clock in the garden is useless after dark and honest all day.
echoes.CUCKOO: The Black Forest clockmakers taught a bird to announce the hour.
echoes.HOURGLASS: Some time can only be measured by watching it run out.
echoes.TOURBILLON: Breguet put the whole escapement in a spinning cage, to cheat gravity.
echoes.CLEPSYDRA: The Athenians limited speeches in court with a jar of dripping water.

name: The Oracle Is Closed
intro: The Oracle at Delphi has stopped answering questions. Instead she has left a set of riddles, each one sworn upon a different god.

echoes.ODYSSEY: The journey home took ten years, and every long journey since has borrowed its name.
echoes.OLYMPUS: The gods live nearly three thousand metres up, above the clouds of Thessaly.
echoes.ORACLE: At Delphi, a priestess breathed the vapours and answered only in riddles.
echoes.TITAN: Before the gods there were their parents, and they were very large.
echoes.HYDRA: Cut off one head and two grow back.
echoes.PROPHECY: Every hero's story begins with someone who already knows how it ends.
echoes.LABYRINTH: Daedalus built it so well that he could barely find his own way out.

name: Insert Coin
intro: The cabinet in the back corner of the arcade has been unplugged since 1987. It still has a high-score table, and the initials on it keep changing.

echoes.JOYSTICK: The pilots called it that first, long before the high scores.
echoes.PIXEL: Up close, every face on the screen is made of tiny squares.
echoes.CARTRIDGE: If it didn't work, you blew on the contacts and tried again.
echoes.PLAYER: One up, two up: somebody has to hold the controls.
echoes.ARCADE: Once it meant a row of arches; now it means a row of glowing cabinets.

name: The Great Work
intro: The alchemist's notebook was written so that only a fellow adept could read it. Every page is a different recipe, and every recipe is a lie with one true ingredient.

echoes.ELIXIR: One sip and you would live forever, or so the label says.
echoes.ALEMBIC: Two glass vessels joined by a beak, where vapour goes to become something purer.
echoes.CRUCIBLE: Everything that matters here was tested in fire, and Arthur Miller named a play after the vessel.
echoes.AZOTH: The adepts' universal solvent takes its name from the first and last letters of three alphabets.
echoes.TRANSMUTE: Lead into gold was always the goal; the change itself was the thing.
echoes.PANACEA: The goddess of the universal remedy was a daughter of Asclepius.

name: Opening Night
intro: Ten minutes before curtain, every part in the pit was swapped for something else. The conductor refuses to go on until the real score is found.

echoes.MAESTRO: The one person on stage who makes no sound at all.
echoes.SYMPHONY: Four movements, a hundred players, and Beethoven wrote nine of them.
echoes.OVERTURE: Before the curtain rises, the orchestra plays a promise of everything to come.
echoes.CRESCENDO: Everything tonight builds, little by little, to one very loud moment.
echoes.ENSEMBLE: No soloists tonight: everyone plays together, or nobody does.
echoes.RHAPSODY: Gershwin wrote his in blue; Queen set theirs in Bohemia.

name: The Night Train
intro: Somewhere between two stations that no longer exist, the night train stopped. When it started again, every ticket had been replaced with a puzzle.

echoes.EXPRESS: Agatha Christie booked a murder on the fastest train out of Istanbul.
echoes.TERMINUS: Every line ends somewhere; the Romans kept a god for boundary stones.
echoes.JUNCTION: Two lines meet, and someone else decides which way you go.
echoes.CABOOSE: The last car of the freight train, where the brakeman kept his stove.
echoes.DERAILED: Something has come off the rails, and not only the train.
echoes.TIMETABLE: The whole railway runs on a printed promise about when things will happen.

name: Seismograph
intro: The needle on the seismograph has started drawing letters. The observatory has twelve hours before the mountain says whatever it is trying to say.

echoes.MAGMA: Below the crust it has another name; it only earns the word lava when it reaches the air.
echoes.CALDERA: When the mountain empties itself, the summit falls in and leaves a cauldron.
echoes.OBSIDIAN: The Aztecs made mirrors and blades from the mountain's black glass.
echoes.TECTONIC: The ground is a jigsaw whose pieces drift a few centimetres every year.
echoes.ERUPTION: Pliny's uncle sailed toward it for a better look, and did not come back.
echoes.EPICENTRE: The damage spreads out in rings from a single point on the surface.

name: Dead Men's Chest
intro: The captain died with the map in his head. Luckily for the crew, he was a paranoid man, and he had it tattooed, in pieces, on each of them.

echoes.TREASURE: Stevenson drew the map first, and wrote the island to fit it.
echoes.PLUNDER: The ship's articles set out exactly how the spoils would be divided.
echoes.GALLEON: Every year the Spanish fleet sailed home low in the water, heavy with silver.
echoes.CUTLASS: A short, heavy blade: far better below decks than any rapier.
echoes.BUCCANEER: The first of them smoked meat on wooden frames in Hispaniola.
echoes.MUTINY: Fletcher Christian took the Bounty. The crew here are considering something similar.

name: The Endgame Study
intro: A grandmaster resigned in a winning position, left the hall, and never played again. His scoresheet was not a game at all.

echoes.GAMBIT: Every good opening starts by giving something away.
echoes.ZUGZWANG: Any move at all will lose, and passing is not allowed.
echoes.CASTLING: The only move where two pieces go at once, and the king hides behind a tower.
echoes.CHECKMATE: The Persian shah was never killed; he was simply left with nowhere to go.
echoes.STALEMATE: No legal moves, not in check, and nobody wins.
echoes.PROMOTION: A pawn that walks all the way across the board can become anything it likes.

name: The Glasshouse
intro: Every plant in the botanic garden's glasshouse bloomed on the same night. The labels in the pots had all been rewritten.

echoes.ORCHID: The Victorians sent collectors to die in jungles for a single rare bloom.
echoes.BLOSSOM: In Kyoto they hold parties just to watch the trees flower.
echoes.MANDRAKE: Pull it from the soil and its scream, they say, will kill you.
echoes.NIGHTSHADE: Italian ladies once dropped belladonna in their eyes to look beautiful.
echoes.TERRARIUM: A sealed glass world that has not been watered since 1960.
echoes.HERBARIUM: Pressed flowers, dried and labelled, filed away like old letters.

name: Isobars
intro: The weather station on the summit has been automated for forty years. This morning its printer woke up and produced something that is definitely not a forecast.

echoes.CYCLONE: The winds turn anticlockwise here, and clockwise on the other side of the world.
echoes.TEMPEST: Prospero raised one to bring his enemies ashore.
echoes.MONSOON: The Arabic word meant simply 'season', and here the season means rain.
echoes.TORNADO: Dorothy's house left Kansas in one.
echoes.HURRICANE: The Taíno named it after a god of chaos.
echoes.MAELSTROM: Poe sent a fisherman down a whirlpool off the coast of Norway.

name: The Travelling Show
intro: The circus arrived overnight in a town that isn't on any map. Admission is free, but the ticket-taker only lets you in if you can read your ticket.

echoes.CAROUSEL: The painted horses go up and down and round, and never get anywhere.
echoes.TRAPEZE: The daring young man flew through the air with the greatest of ease.
echoes.JUGGLER: Five things in the air, and only two hands.
echoes.RINGMASTER: The one in the red coat and top hat, telling everyone where to look.
echoes.MENAGERIE: The Tower of London once kept lions, and nobody thought it strange.
echoes.SPECTACLE: Roll up: the whole show exists only to be looked at.

name: Capture The Flag
intro: The honeypot caught something at 03:14. It was not an attacker. It was a message, split across every protocol the intruder could find.

echoes.FIREWALL: Builders put a brick barrier between houses to stop the flames spreading; the network keeps one too.
echoes.PHREAK: A toy whistle from a cereal box once played exactly 2600 hertz.
echoes.ROOTKIT: The intruder didn't just get in. They moved in, and hid the furniture.
echoes.EXPLOIT: Every bug is a door, and somebody always walks through it.
echoes.HONEYPOT: Leave something sweet out, and watch who comes to take it.
echoes.MALWARE: Software with bad intentions, which is all its name means.

name: Valley Of The Kings
intro: The excavators broke the seal on a tomb that appears on no dynasty list. Every chamber is empty except for a single inscription, carved in a script that is not quite hieroglyphic.

echoes.PHARAOH: The title meant only 'great house', but the house was the king.
echoes.PYRAMID: Four triangular faces, pointing at the sun, over a very small room.
echoes.SPHINX: What walks on four legs in the morning, two at noon and three in the evening?
echoes.SCARAB: The beetle rolls its ball across the sand the way Khepri rolls the sun.
echoes.PAPYRUS: The reeds by the river were split, pressed and dried into the first paper.
echoes.OBELISK: A single needle of granite; London, Paris and New York each carried one home.
